name: 蕭俊祥
objective: 機械手臂基礎理論，內容包含座標轉換、機械臂運動學、反運動學、機械臂控制、機械臂的程式語言、視覺系統與影像處理、移動機器人控制等。

Week 1-2 : Introduction (LabVIEW, Matlab)
Week 3-4 :  Vision system
Week 5-7: Mobile robot controls
Week 8 : 期中考
Week: 9 : Rigid Motions and Homogeneous Transformations
Week 10-12 :  Forward and Inverse Kinematics
Week 13-15 : Robot arm control
Week 16: 期末考
